name: app.vercel.personalized-gifts-guide/gift-catalog
title: Gift Catalog by Personalized Gifts Guide
description: Free, read-only, no API key: filtered gift search, gift guides, helper bots, holiday order-by dates.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search the published Personalized Gifts Guide catalog (Zazzle products, Amazon bundle picks and related guides or bundles) by free text and/or structured filters: recipient, occasion, product type, source. Returns title, product type, the site page, an image (Zazzle), and the already-correct Zazzle or Amazon URL. Prices are not in the feed: price is always null and min_price/max_price only steer guide picks (under-$ guides), never invent prices. Does not invent links. Never returns Coach fashion products. Give a query or at least one filter.

query.description: Search text, for example 'gift for grandma under $30' or 'nana mug'. Optional when a filter is given.

recipient.description: Who it's for. Values: mom, dad, grandma, grandpa, grandparents, couples, pet lovers, baby, kids, family, friends, coworkers, teacher, nurses, graduates, retirees, first responders, golfers, her, runners, athletes, parents-to-be, party hosts, pen pals, small business owners, coffee lovers, new homeowners, gamers, anyone. Common aliases work (mother, nana, wife, dog lover, husband...).

occasion.description: Occasion. Catalog values: Christmas, Hanukkah, Thanksgiving, New Year, Lunar New Year, Valentine's Day, Easter, Father's Day, Graduation, Weddings, Any occasion. Also matched on product titles: birthday, anniversary, mother's day, baby shower, bridal shower, retirement, housewarming, halloween, back to school.

product_type.description: Product type. Values: Mugs & drinkware, Ornaments, Bags & accessories, Cards, Home & textiles, Apparel & socks, Decor & signs, Invitations, Stationery & office, Stickers & labels, Puzzles & games, Party supplies, Badges & name tags, Business cards, Gift wrap, Other. Simple words work too (mug, ornament, shirt, blanket, tote, card, sticker, puzzle).

source.description: Limit to Zazzle (personalized) or Amazon (bundle and GTA 6 gear picks).

min_price.description: Optional. Prices are not in the catalog, so this cannot filter products; it is echoed and noted.

max_price.description: Optional budget in USD. Used to pick matching under-$ guides; products are not price-filtered because the catalog has no prices.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch a published guide or bundle page, including Black Friday, Amazon bundle pages, under-$ guides, and GTA 6 gear. Returns the page URL, summary, and a capped list of already-published product links.

query.description: Guide topic, slug, or URL, for example 'gifts for mom', 'grandma gift bundle', or 'black friday'.

limit.description: Max matching guides to return (default 3, max 5).

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List the live public helper bots from the site's bots.json (name, help, triggers, and share URL).

tools.name: order_by_dates
tools.description: Return the 2026 holiday send-by calendar from the site, including USPS Christmas mail-by dates, Hanukkah dates, FAQs, and the public ICS URL.
